items.headline: MiniMax releases MiniMax-M2.7
items.summary: MiniMax-M2.7 is a coding, office and agent model that MiniMax describes as its first to take part in its own development, used to update its memory, skills and training workflow. MiniMax reports 56.22% on SWE-Pro and 57.0% on Terminal Bench 2; weights later appeared on Hugging Face under a custom license.
